text:
Abyssal Beasts
​
Introduction
Abyssal beasts  are a higher level alternative for Abyssal Slayer creature assignments. They are mainly killed for Slayer  tasks, the Senntisten collection log, combat  /  item experience, profit, and 
​
⬥ Abyssal beasts can be assigned as a Slayer  assignment by Mandrith, Laniakea, Morvran, Kuradal, Duradel, Sumona, and The Raptor.
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Abyssal beasts specific tasks may be assigned by Mandrith.
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Demon cluster tasks also work, they may be assigned by Laniakea, and The Raptor.
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Laniakea assigns almost twice as many.
⬥ The level 35 Wilderness location yields the highest kph.
​
Stats
⬥  level: 105
⬥  XP per kill: 1448.4
⬥ Optimal kills per hour: ~809 , ~790 , ~742 , ~809  (All AFK)
⬥ Optimal  XP per hour: ~1.17m , ~1.15m , ~1.07m , ~1.17m  (All AFK)
​
Desirable drops
⬥ Jaws of the Abyss 
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Required for the Slayer collection log.
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 5 times rarer off-task.
⬥ Abyssal flesh 
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Required to craft 
⬥ Revenant drop enhancer 
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Required for the Slayer collection log.
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Only dropped if killed in the Wilderness.
​
Useful Items and Unlocks


















Owning the following increases the efficiency of your sessions, but is by no means mandatory.

Items
⬥ Slayer Codex 
    • Once 50 souls are added, it can be used to teleport to the Sunken Pyramid.
⬥ Portable obelisk  / Obelisk shard
    • Allows for an easy teleport to the lvl 35 wilderness obelisk.
⬥ Demon horn necklace  and attuned ectoplasmator 
    • Helps sustain your prayer.
⬥ Dwarven siege engine  or Kinetic cyclone 
    • Make sure to have the Restocking Cannon ability unlocked.
Other
⬥ Armour perked with Demon Slayer 
    • +7% damage against demons.
⬥ Stone of Jas buff 
    • 3% damage bonus for 4 hours after visiting the cave.
⬥ Infernal Puzzle Box (tier 6) 
    • 14% damage reduction and 9% damage increase whilst in the Wilderness.
        ⬩ This effect scales with the tier of your puzzle box.
    • Tier 6 allows you to put it in your tool belt.








​
Location and How to Get there
Abyssal beasts can be fought in the Senntisten Asylum, the Wilderness, or the Sunken Pyramid.
​
Senntisten Asylum

⬥ If killing Abyssal beasts at the Senntisten Asylum, use a 
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Go to the second room of the Senntisten Asylum and position yourself 5 tiles east of the west drain.
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Place  4 tiles east of you.
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ If using an  place it 3 tiles north of you.
​
Level 35 Wilderness

⬥ If killing Abyssal beasts at the level 35 Wilderness location, use a 
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Go just north of the level 35 Wilderness obelisk and position yourself 2 tiles north of the skeleton.
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Place  1 tile north, and 9 tiles east of the skeleton.
​
Sunken Pyramid

⬥ If killing Abyssal beasts in the Sunken Pyramid, use a 
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Relocating your house to Menaphos and using a teleport to house tablet also works.
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Place 5 Abyssal beasts in the small room, and position yourself 7 tiles south of the northern statue.
